Messages.Author: hamd...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
Here's a fr'instance:

An Inner Circle member gets bored with his huge voting power and
decides to slum it as a Prince for a while. The vote passes, and he
becomes a prince.

Some other cheeky voter calls a COmmand of the Harpies, and our IC
member loses his title.

Does he then revert to being an Inner Circle member with 4 votes, or is
he a no-friends with no votes?

i.e. If a vampire has votes by default due to a unique title, does a
subsequent title act as a Mask (covering the vampire with a new status
until it is removed) or a Blackboard (erasing the previous title and
replacing with a new one).

DH

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: Sorrow
Messages.Body:
> An Inner Circle member gets bored with his huge voting power and
> decides to slum it as a Prince for a while. The vote passes, and he
> becomes a prince.
> Some other cheeky voter calls a COmmand of the Harpies, and our IC
> member loses his title.
> Does he then revert to being an Inner Circle member with 4 votes, or is
> he a no-friends with no votes?

The IC member loses the 4 votes when s/he becomes Prince. If that
vamp subsequently loses the title of Prince, s/he no longer has any
votes.

From:
http://www.white-wolf.com/VTES/rulings.html

Inner Circle members
* Inner Circle members are titled (and would lose their title if they gain
another).
They derive their votes from their titles (and would lose the votes with
the title),
but the +2 bleed is independent of the title. [TOM 19951217]

Sorrow

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
hamd...@my-deja.com wrote:
>
> Here's a fr'instance:
>

> An Inner Circle member gets bored with his huge voting power and
> decides to slum it as a Prince for a while. The vote passes, and he
> becomes a prince.
>
> Some other cheeky voter calls a COmmand of the Harpies, and our IC
> member loses his title.

No. The *prince* loses his title.
Command of the Harpies doesn't affect IC members.

> Does he then revert to being an Inner Circle member with 4 votes, or is
> he a no-friends with no votes?

He has lost the IC title (back when he gained the prince title) and
there's nothing to indicate that he has received the IC title, so
he has no IC title.

> i.e. If a vampire has votes by default due to a unique title, does a
> subsequent title act as a Mask (covering the vampire with a new status
> until it is removed) or a Blackboard (erasing the previous title and
> replacing with a new one).

See section [6.3.4]
